added.summary: A buffered press: ActionDesc.bufferTicks keeps an action's press for that many ticks after it went down (0: only its own tick), ActionState.buffered says one is waiting, and og.input.consume takes it, true once per press. A jump or a combo pressed a few ticks early happens when the game can act, and one press never does two moves.

When in its tick an action went down, in seconds from the tick's start (-dt to dt), from the time its key or pointer press carried: a rhythm game judges `time.elapsed + pressedAt` against the beat instead of the 16.7 ms tick. It comes from the press events, so a replay gives it again; 0 for a pad or an on-screen control.
